text_block_list.text:
After training, Mejiro McQueen, who was supposed to have gone home,
returned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must build more strength.
Please, let us extend the training session!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...On my way back, I passed Ryan.
She mentioned she was heading off to training now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When she's putting in even more effort,
there's no way I can just rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Always running at the very front, dazzling in everyone's eyes.
That is the kind of racer I strive to be!
choice_data_list: In that case, let's push it to the absolute limit!
I can't allow that if we're talking efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
You truly understand how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're watching over me, Trainer,
I won't push myself too recklessly.
Please guide me thoroughly!
I worked hard training alongside Mejiro McQueen, making sure not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed, it might be overwork, but
with the way power is surging through me right now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No, I may have lost my composure for a brief moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot discipline myself here, there is no future for me.
"Stand dignified"—that is what it means to be a Mejiro...
Telling herself that, Mejiro McQueen walked back home.
